The following events took place in '''232 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] was rediscovered by [[Reidi Artom]].<ref name="Cularin rediscovery date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' mentions that the rediscovery of the Cularin system took place 200 years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. It can therefore be deduced that the rediscovery took place in 232 BBY.</ref>
*[[Rori/Legends|Rori]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], suffers an outbreak of brainworm. The [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] commissions the construction of the [[Restuss]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="THP">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
